chains.title: Candidate CREB3L4-mediated effect at an unannotated site
chains.element: A regulatory element overlapping the variant is hypothetical.

links.claim: QBiC-SELEX predicts stronger binding to ref C than alt T using a model mapped from CREB3L2, but there is no occupancy evidence. CREB3L4 is retained as a testable candidate because it is expressed in MCF7 and more highly expressed there than CREB3L2; that does not establish which factor, if any, binds this site.
No annotated cCRE overlaps the variant, so a regulatory element at this position remains hypothetical.

PELI2 is a provisional target because it is the closest listed protein-coding gene by TSS, but the supplied data do not connect this variant to its expression; the reported molecular QTL is low-PIP and in brain, and there is no significant GTEx eQTL.
MCF7 is a context in which CREB3L4 is expressed, but binding at the variant or activity of a local element in this cell line has not been shown.
A contribution to breast-cancer risk is speculative: no supplied evidence links this variant to breast cancer or establishes a PELI2-mediated effect on the disease.

predictions: If this chain is correct, a sensitive CREB3L4 occupancy assay in relevant breast cells should detect binding at the site, with greater occupancy on ref than alt.

Editing ref to alt should produce a CREB3L4-dependent regulatory effect and, if PELI2 is the target, a reproducible change in PELI2 expression; the expression direction is not predicted by binding alone.
falsified_if: Sensitive assays detect no CREB3L4 occupancy at the site in relevant cells, and allele editing produces no CREB3L4-dependent local regulatory or PELI2 expression effect.

chains.title: Candidate TGIF1-mediated effect at an unannotated site
chains.element: A regulatory element overlapping the variant is hypothetical.

links.claim: QBiC-SELEX predicts stronger binding to ref C than alt T using a TGIF2-mapped model, but there is no TGIF1 occupancy evidence and the model does not distinguish TGIF1 from related factors such as MEIS3. TGIF1 is a testable candidate because it is expressed in MCF7, not because expression establishes it as the binder.
No annotated cCRE overlaps the variant, so a regulatory element at this position remains hypothetical.
PELI2 is a provisional target based on proximity alone; the supplied data do not show that this variant regulates it.
TGIF1 is expressed in MCF7, but neither occupancy at the variant nor activity of a local element in this cell line is demonstrated.
A TGIF1-dependent effect on PELI2 contributing to breast-cancer risk is speculative and is not established by the supplied evidence.

predictions: If this chain is correct, a sensitive TGIF1 occupancy assay should detect binding at the site, greater on ref than alt; a MEIS3-specific assay would not account for the proposed TGIF1-dependent effect.
TGIF1 perturbation should diminish any allele-dependent regulatory effect of editing the site and any resulting PELI2 expression change.
falsified_if: TGIF1 does not occupy the site in relevant cells, or allele editing produces no TGIF1-dependent regulatory effect.
